text:
sam: Heads-up: we're doing a compact base-image rebuild + runtime hardening tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need a short-lived KMS decrypt binding for the staging signer so oncall can unseal sigs during the canary. Also need to ensure cosign verification events are forwarded to SIEM.

rachel: What's the exact access window? we should avoid any permanent IAM changes.

sam: 45 minutes total: 15m prep + 30m canary. Binding must be scoped to the single key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/stage-sign`. No other keys.

igor: Prefer doing this via our infra repo with an ephemeral Terraform resource so it has VCS audit and auto-destroy. Example snippet I'm planning to add:

```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "stage_decrypter_ephemeral" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/stage-sign"
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  members       = ["group:image-signers-ephemeral@redwood.ai"]
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# separate job will run `terraform destroy -target=google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.stage_decrypter_ephemeral` after 45m
```

rachel: OK. Add a required approval step in the PR: PagerDuty acknowledgement + 2nd approver from sec. Also add a quick check in runbook to confirm the binding is gone.

igor: will do. For logging: cosign verify outputs should be sent to datadog logs with the following fields: principal, key_resource, action, image_digest, cosign_version. Use log-shipper tag `image.sig.verify`.

audit-bot: "Forwarding: cosign logs configured to `logs-redwood-image-audit`. Retention set to 18 months per sec policy change 2026-02."

sam: Good. @rachel can you confirm SIEM ACLs so only sec and ops can read the raw keys?

rachel: Confirmed. We'll limit raw key metadata to sec-team and infra-logs; developer read via redacted indexes. Opening ticket IR-482.

igor: Vulnerability triage: grype on the new base showed CVE-2026-1234 (musl influence) flagged as HIGH but backported patch applied in `base-2026-03-05`. Quick grype summary:
```
grype base-2026-03-05
HIGH: 1 (CVE-2026-1234) -- patched
MEDIUM: 1 (libssl) -- upgrade staged
LOW: 4
```
I re-scanned the canary image and the HIGH is resolved.

sam: Nice. Canary plan: 5% traffic to canary pool for 30m, health checks every 10s. ops-bot please schedule.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-06T03:00:00Z for 30m, 5% traffic. Notifying oncall and sec. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/image-rebuild-ephemeral-key.

rachel: Runbook update: add explicit cosign verify snippet + jq filter to emit fields to datadog, and an emergency rollback path (disable canary pool via infra API).

sam: We'll also add an automated audit assertion: after the binding is destroyed, run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and post output to the audit index. If binding still exists, auto-create issue and page sec-oncall.

igor: One last ask: ensure the puppet scheduler job that destroys the binding runs in the same project and has no broader perms. I'll attach the terraform plan in the PR.

rachel: Ack. I'll approve once PR has PD ack + audit-bot log forwarding confirmation.

audit-bot: "Audit note: all cosign events during window will be tagged with `ephemeral-run:1777777777` for easy correlation."

sam: thanks everyone. If anything changes I'll update here. :white_check_mark:
